ValidationRule.description: DCC cases: Account, Contact, Subject and Description are mandatory once the case has moved past Intake/Acknowledgement into the Investigation stage or later.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Disputes_Claims", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Complaints" ), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Stage__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Intake")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Acknowledgement")), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(ContactId), ISBLANK(Subject), ISBLANK(Description) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account, Contact, Subject and Description are required once the case is in the Investigation stage or later.
